structure.unit: Programs, Courses of Instruction and Textbooks

law.catch_line: Parental notification; literacy and Response to Intervention screening and services; certain assessment results
law.text:
Each local school board shall enact a policy to require that timely written notification is provided to the parents of any student who:
Undergoes literacy and Response to Intervention screening and services; or
Does not meet the benchmark on any assessment used to determine at-risk learners in preschool through grade 12, which notification shall include all such assessment scores and subscores and any intervention plan that results from such assessment scores or subscores.
